propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTelecommunicationsApplianceTypeMobileSwitchingCenter
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to MOBILESWITCHINGCENTER.

properties.name: UserCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the user capacity of the device, defined as the maximum number of users that can be active at the same time.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: MaximumNumberOfManagedBSCs
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum number of base station controller (BSC) that can be managed simultaneously by the mobile switching center (MSC).
